## Summary
Lenses checked: correctness, silent-failure, tests, comments.
The new status line truncates the revision to a different length than history and completed. Fix that so the deployment views show the same identifier, which is what the docstring promises.

## Changes
The pull request adds `status(revision, attempt)` and an `attempt_label` helper to `app/display.py`. These produce a "Running: <revision> (attempt N)" line. It also adds two tests in `tests/test_display.py`.

## Critical
(none)

## Important
- app/display.py:14 — correctness — Truncate the status revision to 12 characters like history — For the test `REVISION`, `status` prints `0123456` and `history` prints `0123456789ab`, because `revision[:7]` differs from the `[:12]` slicing at `app/display.py:5` and `app/display.py:9`. This also contradicts the docstring's "using the same identifier as history." The added test at `tests/test_display.py:14-15` checks only the prefix and suffix, so it does not catch the mismatch. — Operators cannot match a running deployment's identifier against history or completion output by exact string, and a 7-character prefix is more likely to be ambiguous. — Fix: Use `revision[:12]`, or a shared helper that `history` and `completed` also call, and extend `test_running_status_contains_attempt` to assert the full string.
